caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers, primarily colored in warm shades of brown. The chest stands on four cabriole legs that end in ball-and-claw feet, with ornate carvings on the knees of the legs and around the lower apron. The chest features three drawers; the top row has two small drawers, while the bottom section has one large drawer, flanked by two small panels. Each drawer is fitted with brass-colored handles, shaped in a symmetrical and decorative form. The central lower drawer panel is adorned with an intricately carved shell motif and stylized leaf patterns, contrasting with the plain wood grain of the surrounding surfaces. The top of the chest has a molded edge with a decorative carved border. The background is a simple off-white or light beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Lowboy
